versions.changelog:
Initial release of the morning-note skill.

- Generates daily investment morning notes with macro, sector, and stock insights.
- Automatically triggered by user keywords or scheduled cron tasks.
- Outputs structured markdown reports to a dated file location.
- Includes macro scan, sector signal summary, portfolio/stock anomalies, and event calendars.
- Integrates with IMA knowledge base for automatic daily note storage.
- Adheres to constraints: 800–1200 words, clear data cut-off time, no individual stock recommendations.
